title: Wooden Sword
body:
"Not the sharpest, but it'll whack a goblin or two."

Description

The Wooden Sword is a flimsy piece of wood made into a sword; it is Starter melee weapon available for purchase for $600. It deals low damage, has a very short cooldown and low knockback.

Like all other starter weapons, it is available without completing The Arena.

You also could obtain a few of these swords at the Item drop for the Segmenter, right at the start of the event.
